SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

2. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   D. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

4. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.

7. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   B. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   D. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

15. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   B. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Say The School never happens in Kenya.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
